reason: Replace the constant main engine reward (+2 per step) with a descent-conditioned reward that only gives positive signal when the main engine is firing AND the lander is descending (vy < 0). This makes hovering less attractive because the main engine reward is no longer available when vy >= 0. Add a small penalty for not descending (when vy >= 0) to further discourage hovering. Increase the success bonus to +200 to make landing more attractive. Keep progress shaping, crash penalty, and regularizers unchanged. The descent reward is kept but its scale is increased to 1.0 to provide stronger shaping for reducing vertical speed.
